description: This file defines a utility class 'NaturalStrings' providing static methods for natural string comparison operations, including locale-aware and ASCII-based comparators that handle embedded numeric values.

classes.name: NaturalStrings
classes.description: A final utility class providing static methods for natural string comparison, handling embedded numbers and locale-specific ordering.

methods.name: getNaturalComparator
methods.description: Returns a comparator that compares strings with embedded numbers based on their numeric values and other parts using current locale rules.

methods.name: getNaturalComparator(final Collator collator)
methods.description: Returns a comparator that compares strings with embedded numbers based on their numeric values, using a specified Collator for locale-specific comparison of non-number substrings.

methods.name: compareNatural(String s, String t)
methods.description: Default comparison of two strings using current locale's rules, handling embedded numbers.

methods.name: compareNatural(Collator collator, String s, String t)
methods.description: Comparison of strings using a given Collator for non-number parts and handling embedded numeric values.

methods.name: getNaturalComparatorAscii
methods.description: Returns a comparator for ASCII strings that compares embedded numbers numerically and other characters based on Unicode values.

methods.name: getNaturalComparatorIgnoreCaseAscii
methods.description: Returns a case-insensitive comparator for ASCII strings with embedded numbers compared numerically.

methods.name: compareNaturalAscii
methods.description: Compare two ASCII strings, handling embedded numbers case-sensitively.

methods.name: compareNaturalIgnoreCaseAscii
methods.description: Compare two ASCII strings, case-insensitively, handling embedded numbers.
